household.name: stav, staff
household.title: stav, staff

household.name: nål
household.title: nål
household.reason: An iron needle/awl with a bone handle in a fox-skin sheath bound with guanaco sinew, collected from the Selk'nam (Ona) of Tierra del Fuego in 1906 — a characteristic everyday tool of this people.

household.name: korg, basket
household.title: korg, basket
household.reason: A coiled/woven basket with twisted handles, consistent with Selk'nam (Ona) basketry from Tierra del Fuego as documented in the museum record acquired from the Museo Missionario-Etnologico del Laterano. Clear traditional household object matching the claimed culture.

household.name: väska, bag, bolsa
household.title: väska, bag, bolsa

arms.name: båge med sträng, bow
arms.title: båge med sträng, bow
arms.reason: A traditional wooden bow with string, made from Fagus antarctica (Tierra del Fuego beech), collected among the Selk'nam (Ona) of Tierra del Fuego — a classic self-bow type used by this people for hunting.

arms.name: slunga
arms.title: slunga
arms.reason: A leather bola (slunga/sling) with sinew cords and a fabric pouch, a known traditional Selk'nam weapon documented by Gusinde in his ethnography of Tierra del Fuego peoples. This is a genuine hunting/throwing weapon made and used by the Selk'nam.

arms.name: koger

arms.name: kniv, knife
arms.title: kniv, knife

arms.name: koger

arms.name: båge, bow
